title: Release Manifest Schema
content: JSON schema specification for .release-manifest.json file generated during build process.

items.title: Schema overview
items.what: Release manifest tracks metadata for each build
items.how: File: .release-manifest.json in build-output folder — Contains version, git info, changes, backup refs, rollback command

items.title: Field: version
items.what: Semantic version string

items.title: Field: timestamp
items.what: ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC

items.title: Field: project
items.what: Project name string

items.title: Field: branch
items.why: Track which git branch was built
items.what: Git branch name

items.title: Field: buildOutputPath
items.why: Reference where build output is located
items.what: Relative path to build output folder

items.title: Object: git
items.what: Object with commit hash, tag, author
items.how: Fields: commit (string, short hash), tag (string, git tag), author (string, committer name)

items.title: git.commit
items.what: Git commit hash (short or full)

items.title: git.tag
items.what: Git tag string

items.title: git.author
items.what: Name of person/system that built release

items.title: Object: changes
items.why: Track what changed in this release
items.what: Object with file change counts and description
items.how: Fields: filesAdded (number), filesModified (number), filesDeleted (number), totalChanged (number), description (string)

items.title: changes.filesAdded
items.what: Number of files added since last release

items.title: changes.filesModified
items.what: Number of files modified since last release

items.title: changes.filesDeleted
items.what: Number of files deleted since last release

items.title: changes.totalChanged
items.what: Total files that changed (added + modified + deleted)

items.title: changes.description
items.what: Human-readable description of changes
items.how: Example: 'Added deployment infrastructure, updated rules, created build scripts'

items.title: Object: database
items.what: Object with backup location and timestamp

items.title: database.backupLocation
items.why: Know where database backup is stored
items.what: Path to backup file (created on hosting)

items.title: database.backupTimestamp
items.what: ISO 8601 timestamp

items.title: database.note
items.what: Freeform note about backup
items.how: Example: 'Database snapshot created on hosting before release'

items.title: Object: rollbackInfo
items.what: Object with rollback command and previous version

items.title: rollbackInfo.rollbackCommand
items.what: Shell command to rollback to previous version

items.title: rollbackInfo.previousVersion
items.why: Know which version to rollback to
items.what: Previous release version tag

items.title: Field: releaseNotes
items.what: Description of release highlights
items.how: Example: 'Production release v2.0.0 with deployment workflow, 4 new rules, testing framework'

items.title: Complete example manifest
items.what: Full JSON example
items.how: {"version":"v2.0.0","timestamp":"2025-12-22T14:30:00Z","project":"doc-site","branch":"main","buildOutputPath":"projects/doc-site/build-output/","git":{"commit":"fa5c97f","tag":"v2.0.0","author":"Norman"},"changes":{"filesAdded":8,"filesModified":5,"filesDeleted":0,"totalChanged":13,"description":"Deployment infrastructure"},"database":{"backupLocation":"backups/v2.0.0-backup.tar.gz","backupTimestamp":"2025-12-22T14:28:00Z","note":"Snapshot on hosting"},"rollbackInfo":{"rollbackCommand":"git checkout v1.9.9","previousVersion":"v1.9.9"},"releaseNotes":"Production release with deployment workflow"}
